name: Yǒngzhě Dàbàozǒu
summary: Yongzhe Dabaozou is a card-based RPG told from the perspective of an “Chosen One” who has awakened in a world of immortal cultivation. Players will be transported to a shattered and reborn primordial world. On this continent where immortals and demons coexist, they can master ancient arcane arts, ride a variety of fantastical mounts, and fight side by side with ancient divine beasts that have taken human form and primordial treasures whose artifact spirits have awakened, forging their own epic legend in a world where reality and illusion intertwine.
